title: Daniel Ek - Enabling Creators Everywhere - [Invest Like the Best, EP. 242]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today is a special episode because it marks five years since I released the first episode of Invest Like the Best..
reader_summary.overview: Today is a special episode because it marks five years since I released the first episode of Invest Like the Best. Over those years, I’ve learned so much from so many investors and builders, but today’s guest may have taught me the most. Daniel Ek is the CEO and founder of Spotify, and I find him to be one of the most thoughtful business leaders in the world.

key_points.text: Daniel is the perfect guest for this special occasion because he exemplifies the curiosity, humility, leadership.
In our conversation, we discuss the differences between the world of bits and atoms, how Daniel gets up to speed in challenging new fields.
We then bring the discussion back to Spotify, the evolving creator ecosystem.
